news.title: Bret Taylor’s Sierra buys YC-backed AI startup Fragment
news.description: Sierra, the AI customer service agent startup founded by technologist Bret Taylor, announced today that it has acquired the YC-backed French startup Fragment.

news.title: Meet Noscroll, an AI bot that does your doomscrolling for you
news.description: Noscroll wants to cure doomscrolling with an AI bot that reads the internet for you.

news.title: OpenAI releases GPT-5.5, bringing company one step closer to an AI ‘super app’
news.description: OpenAI says its latest model offers increased capabilities across a broad variety of categories.

news.title: Era raises $11M to build a software platform for AI gadgets
news.description: Era thinks that we will see many form factors of AI hardware, including glasses, rings, and pendants.

news.title: Meta to cut one in 10 jobs after spending billions on AI
news.description: The cuts, which employees had been expecting for weeks, will be Meta's largest layoff since 2023.

news.title: White House memo claims mass AI theft by Chinese firms
